title: /ui/multiview returns a bare {error} with no ok key when the framebuffer is 0x0
description: ixdar.automation.endpoints.ui.MultiviewScreenshot answers a 0x0 framebuffer (minimised or not yet shown window) with a JSON object holding only error, no ok key, unlike every other failure, which goes through AutomationEndpoint.failure() since ENG-34. Clients that test response['ok'] raise a KeyError. Found by ENG-34. Return failure(message) there.
definition-of-done:
1. The 0x0 framebuffer case returns {ok:false, error} through AutomationEndpoint.failure().
2. No route in ixdar.automation answers a failure without an ok key.
testing-plan: 1. Unit test or a minimised-window run of ixdar-cli multiview; paste the response.
